description: The report that is safe to attach to a bug report: build, environment, repository, index, cache, config layers, watcher, the last shell run's own frame numbers and the consent table, every finding with a remedy. No config values, no absolute home paths, no URL credentials.

build.description: os, arch, libc, terminal and the instant the report describes.

config.description: Path, size and mtime per config layer - never the values.

frames.description: The last `fathom tui` run of this repository, measured by the shell itself (`reco-08r`): how many draws and events the loop handled, the 99th-percentile and worst draw time of the measurement window, how many of that window's draws missed ADR-002 §6's frame budget, the frame size they were drawn at, and how the loop ended. The shell prints the same numbers as one line when it exits and leaves them at `.fathom/frame-report.json`; `recorded: false` is the stated answer for a repository where no shell has run since the record existed, and `compiled_in: false` for a binary built without the shell. A measurement, not a finding: it never moves the exit code, not even under `--deep` or `--strict`.

recorded.description: False when there was no record to read; the numbers below are present only when true.

path.description: Repository-relative, like every path this report may carry (ADR-002 §11.1).

error.description: Present instead of the numbers when a record exists and could not be read.

compiled_in.description: False in a binary built without the `tui` feature, which has no frame to have measured.

fathom.description: The version that measured them, because a budget met by one build says nothing about another.

started_ms.description: The instant the screen was taken.

ended_ms.description: The instant it was handed back; `ended_ms - started_ms` is how long the reviewer was in the frame.

end.description: How the loop ended, in the words the shell prints: `quit`, `no producer left`, `frame limit reached`, `nothing more to draw`, `signal SIGINT`.

window_frames.description: The denominator of p99_ms, worst_ms and over_budget: the window holds the last 128 draws, so a long session's percentiles are about its last frames, not all of them.

over_budget.description: Draws in the window that missed the budget. The acceptance run's missing number.

sqlite.description: Version, compile options and ADR-004 §4.0's capability probe.

watch.description: `e1.9`'s watcher report: the backend chosen and any running heartbeat.

hooks.description: The harness event stream's health, so a bug report about the stream is a bug report that already answers 'how far behind is it'. ADR-005 §3.1 requires `fathom doctor` to name every file it reads or writes, and this is the section that names the events file; the full report is `fathom hooks --json` (schemas/hooks.schema.json). Absent-key false is not possible: the section is always produced, and a stream that could not be read says so in `error`.

error.description: Present instead of the counters when the stream could not be read at all.

privacy_posture.description: The `e6.8` (reco-h7p) privacy posture as data, so a machine reaches the same conclusion `--privacy` prints for a human: which outbound features are compiled into this binary, where consent could have come from (user-scoped only), what a repository file tried to grant and was ignored, and the local-only claim. Nothing here is measured from the network: the offline proof is `tools/check_privacy.py`, named in `proven_by`.

outbound_compiled_in.description: The `net-*` features in this build. Empty is the default build's answer, and the strongest one.

consent_scope.description: `privacy.*` is user-scoped: a repository may not grant it (ADR-001 §4.6).

path.description: `~`-relative where it can be, like every path in this report.

consent_ignored_from_repository.description: Keys this repository's own `fathom.toml` set true and that this build read and discarded.

telemetry.description: No endpoint, no identifier, no background writer. Not a default: the only shipped state.

local_only.description: The sentence the text rendering prints, so the two renderings cannot disagree.

proven_by.description: Where the claim is checked mechanically, not asserted.

title: fathom doctor --json

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: OK
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: the verb answered, and the index describes HEAD

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: USAGE
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: clap rejected the command line (bad flag, unknown verb, missing value)

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: NOT_A_REPOSITORY
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: --root is not a git repository, or `.git` is unreadable

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: STORE_CORRUPT
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: the store failed its integrity checks

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: CONFIG_INVALID
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: `fathom.toml` failed the schema, or a value is the wrong type

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: FEATURE_ABSENT
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: the verb needs a feature this binary was not built with

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: INDEX_DEGRADED
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: the index is missing, stale, incomplete, or a run never closed
